prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic action scene depicting a giant police robot fighting a giant mechanical gorilla at a Japanese port. The police robot on the left is white and black with red siren lights on its shoulders and head, featuring the text "警視庁" and "MPD" on its chest plates and arms. It has a complex sensor array for a head. The enemy on the right is a massive, dark grey, heavily armored robotic gorilla with glowing red eyes and an open, roaring mouth. The two robots are locked in combat; the gorilla's fist is smashing into the police robot's shoulder, creating sparks and flying debris. In the foreground bottom-left, there is a Japanese police car (black and white) with "警視庁 MPD" written on the side and flashing red lights. In the foreground bottom-right, a police officer wearing a helmet and tactical vest with "警視庁 MPD" on the back is seen from behind, holding a radio or camera. The background features a busy industrial harbor with shipping containers, cranes, and a large suspension bridge under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

promptZh: 一段电影感十足的超写实动作场景：一台巨型警用机器人正在日本港口与一只巨大的机械猩猩展开激战。左侧的警用机器人采用黑白配色，肩部和头部装有红色警示灯，胸甲和手臂上印有“警視庁”和“MPD”字样，头部由一套复杂的传感器阵列构成。右侧的敌人是一只体型庞大、身披深灰色重型装甲的机械猩猩，双眼泛着红光，正张开血盆大口发出怒吼。两台机器人正激烈缠斗；猩猩的重拳狠狠砸在警用机器人的肩膀上，瞬间火花四溅、碎片横飞。画面左下方的前景中停着一辆黑白涂装的日本警车，车身侧面写着“警視庁 MPD”，车顶红灯闪烁。右下方的前景里，一名头戴头盔、身穿战术背心的警察以背影示人，背心背面印有“警視庁 MPD”，他手中正举着对讲机或相机。背景是一座繁忙的工业港口，集装箱与起重机错落分布，一座大型悬索桥横跨其间，头顶是湛蓝的天空与朵朵白云。
